title: 第四十二章 金陵清算第十三章 以弱自保
content_zh:
欧阳长青是第七天夜里从天幕山庄出来的。
没有人知道他为什么选在这个时间。
他走出大门的时候，身上穿着一件洗得发白的旧袍子，头发用一根布带束在脑后，脚上踩着一双布鞋。
不像一个山庄的主人。
像一个要去远行的旅人。
他站在门口，回头看了一眼那座他住了二十年的宅子。
大门上挂着一块匾，上面写着“天幕山庄”四个字，金漆已经黯淡了。门前的那对石狮子，一只的底座裂了一道缝，是前几天夜里有人拿大锤砸的。
他没有让人修。
他已经没有心思去管这些了。
他转过身，沿着街道，一步一步往前走。
街上的行人看到他，先是愣了一下，然后纷纷让开。
有人认出了他。
“是欧阳长青。”
“他怎么出来了？”
“穿成这样……是要去哪？”
议论声像风一样传开。
欧阳长青没有理会。
他走得很慢。
每一步都踩得实实的。
他走过金陵城最热闹的十字街口，走过醉仙楼，走过那些他曾经一句话就能让店主赔笑的地方。

没有人敢上前搭话。
他走完了整条街，在城门口停下来。
城外是一片荒野。
月光照在野草上，泛着一层冷冷的白。
他站在那里，像是在等什么人。
等了大约一炷香的时间，身后传来脚步声。
他没有回头。
“你来了。”
萧无恨站在他身后，手里握着剑。
“我知道你会来。”
欧阳长青转过身，看着他。
“我也知道你会找到我。”
“你留了记号。”
“对。”欧阳长青说，“我留了记号。从山庄门口，一直留到城门口。我怕你找不到我。”
“为什么。”
“因为我想死在你手里。”
欧阳长青说这句话的时候，语气很平静。
“我活了四十五年，该做的事都做了。该抢的抢了，该杀的杀了。我这一生，没什么遗憾。”
他停了一下。
“唯一不甘心的，是败了。”
content_en:
Ouyang Changqing came out of Tianmu Villa on the night of the seventh day.
No one knows why he chose this time.
When he walked out of the door, he was wearing an old robe that had been washed white, his hair was tied back with a cloth belt, and he had a pair of cloth shoes on his feet.
Not like the owner of a mountain villa.
Like a traveler going on a long journey.
He stood at the door and looked back at the house where he had lived for twenty years.
There is a plaque hanging on the door with the words "Tianmu Villa" written on it. The gold paint has faded. One of the pair of stone lions in front of the door had a crack in its base. Someone had smashed it with a sledgehammer a few nights ago.
He didn't let anyone fix it.
He no longer has the mind to care about this.
He turned around and walked forward step by step along the street.
When pedestrians on the street saw him, they were stunned for a moment and then moved out of the way.
Someone recognized him.
"It's Ouyang Changqing."
"Why did he come out?"
"You're dressed like this...where are you going?"
The discussion spread like the wind.
Ouyang Changqing ignored it.
He walked very slowly.
Every step is taken seriously.
He walked through the busiest crossroads in Jinling City, walked past Zuixian Tower, and walked past places where he could make shopkeepers laugh with just one word.
No one dared to come up and talk to him.
He walked the entire street and stopped at the city gate.
Outside the city is a wilderness.
The moonlight shines on the wild grass, glowing with a cold white color.
He stood there as if waiting for someone.
After waiting for about a stick of incense, footsteps came from behind.
He didn't look back.
"You're here."
Xiao Wuhen stood behind him, holding a sword in his hand.
"I knew you were coming."
Ouyang Changqing turned around and looked at him.
"I also know you'll find me."
"You left a mark."
"Yes." Ouyang Changqing said, "I left a mark. From the entrance of the villa to the gate of the city. I'm afraid you can't find me."
"Why."
"Because I want to die in your hands."
When Ouyang Changqing said this, his tone was very calm.
"I have lived for forty-five years and have done everything I should do. I have robbed what should be robbed and killed what should be killed. I have no regrets in this life."
He paused.
"The only thing I'm not willing to accept is defeat."
